title: SseFrame::id Option<String> is public API — fixing None-conflation is a breaking change
description: SseFrame is pub and non_exhaustive. The id field is pub Option<String>. If/when the conflation in JMAP-bu1.1 is fixed (by introducing a tri-state enum), changing the type of id from Option<String> to a new enum is a semver-breaking change. Every caller pattern-matching or reading SseFrame::id breaks. The right fix (tri-state) cannot be applied silently. Should be fixed now before any callers exist in the wild.
